title: Next.js with Drizzle and PostgreSQL
about: A server-rendered Next.js 15 application (App Router, a server action) that lists and creates posts in PostgreSQL through Drizzle ORM. Every tool builds it with `next build` and deploys it the OpenNext way: a server function, static assets, an image optimizer and a CDN in front.
changesFromStarter: `next` is 15.5.26 instead of the starter's 15.4.6. The OpenNext releases SST and the CDK construct build with refuse 15.4.6: their supported ranges start at 15.4.11 (SST's OpenNext 3.9.14) and 15.5.15 (OpenNext 3.10.4).
Every other direct dependency is pinned to an exact version, the newest within the starter's own range.

stacktape: Stacktape's defaults: Node.js 24, ESM, a source map without embedded sources, `@aws-sdk/*` left to the runtime, shared code split into a layer when several functions use it.
cdk: Project layout, `cdk.json` (87 feature flags, `"app": "npx tsc && npx tsx bin/<app>.ts"`) and `tsconfig.json` are what `cdk init app --language typescript` writes (aws-cdk 2.1142.0), minus Jest. Every synth type-checks the project first, as a CDK user's does. `esbuild` is a devDependency, so bundling is local, not in Docker.
`NodejsFunction` defaults: no minification, no source map, CommonJS, `@aws-sdk/*` left to the runtime for an explicit Node.js 24 runtime.

`cdk-nextjs-standalone` 4.3.3, the first CDK option in OpenNext's docs; every synth runs `npx @opennextjs/aws@^3 build` (3.10.4) and needs a `zip` executable. The CDK project keeps the application's TypeScript 5.9.3.
sst: `sst.aws.Function` defaults in 4.17.1: Node.js 24, ESM, not minified (the docs say `minify` defaults to true; 4.17.1 does not apply it), a source map uploaded to SST's bucket rather than shipped in the zip, and the AWS SDK bundled unless `nodejs.esbuild.external` names it, which these configurations do where the application imports the SDK.

sstNotDeployed: `sst diff` builds the site only when its inputs are known. This site's environment carries the database's outputs, so a preview of a stage that was never deployed builds nothing (measured: the preview ran, `.open-next` was not created), and deploying it needs RDS, a NAT gateway and CloudFront, which the benchmark's AWS rules keep for tests that are about them.

notPackageable.cdk: `cdk-nextjs-standalone` 4.3.3 passes `environment` to `next build` as unresolved CDK tokens; the application parses the database URL when the page module loads, so `next build` fails with `Invalid URL` (`postgresql://${Token[TOKEN.127]}:...`).
